text_block_list.text:
I spot Нарита Брайан at the academy after
a break.

...I went out to the sticks for a student
council
inspection.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
But the president can't pass up a good
time. She's
got to sample the local
cuisine, visit the hot
springs, yada yada...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
An "inspection," she called it... Can you
believe
that?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It seems like Нарита Брайан had a nice,
relaxing
time with her friends.
